cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Choose the Precedent
cards.instruction: Make someone choose which rule, custom, or prior decision will govern what happens now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Grandma or the birthday child at the head of the table? I taught you both family traditions; now you're hosting, choose which one comes first.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, you've finally made room for both. Now use the serving order we practised: who gets the first plate?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Serve them together. There's only one birthday pudding, though.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then choose who gets the wish: elders first or birthdays first. You can cut equal slices afterward; I taught you portions, not how to divide a wish.

reason: Make the former pupil relationship determine which concession, record, interpretation or practical method A asks for, with each new B contribution changing the next request.
